issue.title: Add Multi-Take Recording to Record Tab
issue.body: The Record Tab's initial build supports a single draft per unit, with re-record silently overwriting the existing take. FIA-style OBT workflows require multiple takes per passage: a team records the same passage several times, listens back to each take, selects the best, and optionally records a final version. This ticket extends the Record Tab's Review state to support multiple takes per unit with compact per-take playback and selection. ## Functional Requirements ### Idle State - When no takes exist for a unit, the Idle state is unchanged from #49: display the enlarged Record button (`li:circle-dot`) with no take list. ### Take List - When at least one take exists, display a vertically scrollable list of take cards below the playback controls. - Each card displays: take number (e.g., "Take 1"), a compact inline waveform amplitude visualization, duration, a play/pause button (`li:play` / `li:pause`), and a selection indicator (`li:circle` when unselected, `li:circle-check` when selected). - Cards are compact (56–64dp tall) to maximize the number of takes visible without scrolling. - Tapping the play/pause button on a card plays or pauses that take inline; playback of one take stops any other take currently playing. - Tapping the selection indicator marks that take as the active draft; only one take can be selected at a time. - The selected card is visually distinguished with a filled checkmark (`li:circle-check`) and a highlighted border. - A "Record New Take" button appears below the take list; tapping it begins a new recording and transitions to the recording state. - The take list is capped at 5 takes per unit. When the cap is reached, "Record New Take" is disabled; the user must delete a take before recording an additional one. ### Recording a New Take - When recording begins from the "Record New Take" button, the take list collapses so the waveform and recording controls have full focus. - Recording controls behave identically to the base Record Tab: pause/resume appends to the current take; stop commits it. - On stop, the new take is appended to the bottom of the list, automatically selected as the active draft, and the take list is restored. ### Deleting a Take - Each take card includes a `li:trash-2` icon on the trailing edge. - Tapping `li:trash-2` on a non-selected take removes it immediately with no confirmation prompt. - Tapping `li:trash-2` on the selected take shows a confirmation prompt before removing it; on confirm, the next available take is automatically selected. - Take numbering is cumulative and does not reset when a take is deleted. - If the last take is deleted, the unit returns to the Idle state. > **Note:** The initial Record Tab ticket (#49) specifies that Re-record silently overwrites. This ticket replaces that behavior: Re-record no longer appears in the Review state; "Record New Take" is the entry point for additional takes instead. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) Extend the Record Tab Review state so a translator can keep multiple takes per unit, play any take inline, select one active draft, record additional takes, and delete takes — replacing silent re-record overwrite from #49. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Land / depend on the single-draft Record Tab from **#49** (in-flight PR path: `src/app/tabs/drafting/record/*`, `useVerseRecorder`, `recordingStorage`) before changing Review UX. 2. Persist multi-take rows using existing `recordings.take_number` / `is_latest` columns; implement selection semantics with **#98** (do not keep the single-row overwrite model from the #49 draft if it conflicts). 3. Replace Review “Re-record” with a take list + “Record New Take”; collapse list while recording; restore and auto-select the new take on stop. 4. Per-card playback must stop any other playing take (share one playback controller keyed by take id). 5. Delete: immediate for non-selected; confirm for selected; promote next take to `is_latest`; idle when none remain; delete local files via recording storage. ### Systems / modules / anchors - UI: `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx` (stub on `main`); expected #49 tree under `src/app/tabs/drafting/record/` - Screen shell: `src/app/screens/DraftingScreen.tsx`, `src/app/context/DraftingContext.tsx` - Schema: `src/db/schema.ts` → `recordings` (`take_number`, `is_latest`, `local_file_path`, `duration_ms`) - Reads/writes: `src/db/queries.ts`, `src/db/repository.ts` (recording CRUD largely missing on `main`; #49/#98 add) - Storage: `src/services/recordingStorage.ts` (from #49) - Types: `src/types/recording/types.ts` (from #49) - Icons: Lucide names in product copy map to existing vector-icon usage in the app ### Implementation steps 1. Confirm #49 Review/Idle/Recording states are merged or branched from. 2. Add repository/query APIs: list takes for verse/unit, set selected (`is_latest`), append take, delete take + file. 3. Build compact take-card list UI (56–64dp) under playback controls. 4. Wire per-take play/pause and exclusive playback. 5. Wire “Record New Take” → collapse list → existing recorder → append + select. 6. Wire delete + confirmation for selected take; return to Idle when empty. 7. Remove/hide Re-record from Review per product note. 8. Unit tests for selection/delete/append; component tests for list states. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** #49 (Record Tab base), #98 (multi-take persistence semantics). Related audio epic #116 (#94–#97, #176). - **External:** None for local multi-take UI. Upload of selected take only is covered by recording sync epic #117 / #100 — not required to ship #71 UI/persistence. - **Assumption:** “Unit” maps to the same recording key space #49 uses (verse / `bible_text_id` + user). Confirm if project-unit granularity differs. ### Edge cases & failure states - Mid-recording app kill: reuse #49 recovery; incomplete take must not corrupt the list. - Deleting the only take → Idle; deleting selected with siblings → auto-select next (define order: highest take number vs previous). - Playback while another take records: disallow or stop playback (match #49 guards). - Disk full / file missing for a listed take: show failed card state; allow delete. - Sync: only `is_latest` should be upload-eligible later; changing selection must flip flags without orphaning files. ### Testing & verification - Automated: repository multi-take tests; Record Tab tests for Idle / list / record-new / delete confirm. - Manual (Android device required — mic/filesystem): record 3+ takes, exclusive playback, select, delete selected/non-selected, last-take → Idle, Record New Take collapse/restore. - Gates: `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci` ### Analytics / observability / migrations - Logging via `logger` for take append/select/delete failures (no PII/audio paths in production logs beyond ids). - Schema columns already exist; #98 may still need migration/index changes — coordinate so #71 does not invent a parallel schema. - No analytics events specified — **out of scope** unless product adds them. ### Assumptions - #49 lands before or as a prerequisite branch for this work. - Waveform on take cards can reuse the compact amplitude approach from #49/#96; exact asset format TBD with playback engine. - Android-only; ignore any iOS-specific guidance elsewhere. ### Open questions 1. After deleting the selected take, which sibling becomes selected (next higher take number, previous, or most recently recorded)? 2. Should non-latest takes remain on disk indefinitely until user deletes, or is there a retention cap? 3. Does “active draft” selection need to sync to the server immediately, or only affect local `is_latest` until upload (#117)? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Idle with zero takes matches #49 (enlarged Record control, no list). - [ ] With ≥1 take, Review shows scrollable compact take cards (number, waveform, duration, play/pause, selection indicator). - [ ] Only one take selected (`is_latest`); selection UI and storage stay in sync. - [ ] Exclusive inline playback across take cards. - [ ] “Record New Take” collapses list, records via existing controls, appends + auto-selects, restores list. - [ ] Delete non-selected: immediate; delete selected: confirm then select another; last take → Idle. - [ ] Review no longer offers silent Re-record overwrite. - [ ] Unit/component tests cover list/selection/delete; Android device QA recorded on the PR.

comments.body: **Test Results #71** - The idle state is displayed correctly with the enlarged Record button when no takes are available. - The take list is displayed correctly after recording, showing the take number, waveform, duration, play/pause button, selection indicator, and delete icon. - Users can play, pause, and select a take successfully, and only one take can be selected at a time. - Recording a new take works correctly. The take list collapses during recording, and the new take is added to the bottom of the list and selected automatically after recording stops. - The Record New Take button is disabled after reaching the maximum limit of five takes, preventing additional recordings. - Deleting takes works correctly. Non-selected takes are deleted immediately, selected takes show a confirmation prompt, and the app returns to the idle state when the last take is deleted. **Issue Identified:** The recording timer overlaps the audio waveform after a take is recorded. Move the timer above the waveform to the right side. Moving this ticket to inprogress
